claims.text: The Ottoman Empire was founded around 1299 and ruled by sultans until 1922.
The Mughal Empire, the Safavid Empire and the Mamluk Sultanate had all ended long before 1922.
The last Ottoman sultan, Mehmed VI, left aboard a British warship in November 1922.
The Republic of Turkey was proclaimed in 1923.
